sources.entry: 15. Image-to-Text with Clip Interrogator - A tool for converting images to descriptive text.

summary.name: CLIP Interrogator
summary.one_liner: A Colab notebook that analyzes an image and generates a descriptive text prompt for recreating similar images with Stable Diffusion.
use_cases: Finding a prompt to create new images similar to an existing one
Reverse-engineering prompts from images for Stable Diffusion
Comparing how CLIP models rank terms for an image
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Google Colab notebook for CLIP Interrogator version 2.4 by pharmapsychotic. It takes an existing image and produces a text prompt intended to help create new images similar to it. The notebook is tuned for Stable Diffusion prompts and states that this version achieves higher alignment between the generated prompt and the source image. Users choose a CLIP model based on their Stable Diffusion version: ViT-L for SD 1.X and ViT-H for SD 2.0+. The page also links to an older version 1 that shows how different CLIP models rank terms.
notable: Chooses CLIP model by Stable Diffusion version (ViT-L for SD 1.X, ViT-H for SD 2.0+)
Version 2.4 optimized for Stable Diffusion prompts with higher image alignment
Older version 1 available for comparing how CLIP models rank terms
caveats: Page does not state pricing or licensing terms for the notebook
Page text does not describe runtime requirements such as GPU needs
